7Read Aylin’s email. Mark T or F and correct the false statements.

Dear Eylül,

I am now in Eskişehir. My school is small, but it has a lovely garden and a bright computer room. Mr Akın is our English teacher. He helps us learn new songs. Ms Deniz is the nurse, and Mr Eren is our PE teacher. We play volleyball with him in the gym.

I am in the reading club. We read short stories in Room 6 every Friday. We must bring our books, and we cannot eat during club time. We must not leave rubbish in the garden.

Our Children’s Day show is in the gym at 10.30. Selin dances in the show, and I sing with the choir. I am excited!

Write soon! Aylin
